SearchAliases: study for a lifetime is complete
Senses.Note: Three Tier 2 works retain the declaration, including a direct saying and two later uses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此四句內，有一句能縱、能奪、能殺、能活，有人簡點得出，一生參學事畢。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB177.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Poshan: Poshan Haiming is the exact actor of this headword-bearing turn.

Occurrences.Kwic: 者裏勘破得來，一生參學事畢。

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: compiler of Raising Old Cases owns the exact headword-bearing action or line in the complete retained case; the adjacent question, quotation, or response was read separately.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1296.xml). Compilation of the School Gate’s “Raising Old Cases”: compiler of Raising Old Cases is the exact actor or actor-class recorded for this headword-bearing text.

Occurrences.Kwic: 乃舉：「昔日長慶稜和尚示眾云：『撞著道伴交肩過，一生參學事畢。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J40/J40nB494.xml). Recorded Sayings of Monk Yushan: Changqing Huileng is the exact actor of this headword-bearing turn.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂，拈起拄杖曰：識得這箇，一生參學事畢。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete 5 Lamps 34–120. Speaker: Dun'an Zongyan.

Senses.Explanation: A lifetime’s inquiry is finished is a declaration of completion. Poshan Haiming says it of distinguishing a line that can release, seize, kill, or enliven; the old-case collection and Monk Yushan’s record preserve the same conclusion in later case use.
